transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

Hi. Well, I came in because I just feel worn out all the time. It's like... even after a full night in bed, my body feels like it's made of sandbags. Just getting through a regular workday, or even just doing something simple like folding the laundry, it takes absolutely everything I have right now.
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?

Yes, I have. Most days, honestly. I wake up and there's just this... heavy, flat feeling right in my chest. I can just sit at the kitchen table, staring out at the yard, and I just feel like there is no good version of the future coming. It's just very bleak.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?

Yeah, I have. Um... I used to always make time for things like hiking, yoga, working in my garden... I also really like taking bird photos. But lately, I just keep canceling plans. My camera has just been sitting in the closet. It's like... none of it really feels worth the effort right now.
Have you had thoughts that life isn’t worth living, or thoughts of harming yourself?

Yeah, I have. Um... mostly late at night, I'll catch myself thinking that my husband might just be better off without me. I haven't actually made a plan to do anything, but... the thought just keeps coming back. It happens often enough that it really scares me.
How long have you been feeling this way?
Um... I'd say this depressed, slowed-down part... just feeling so exhausted all the time... it's been going on most days for about the past two months.
Before these past two months, have you ever had another period in your life when you felt depressed like this?
Um, no, I don't think so. I mean, I've had bad days before, or felt down for a little bit, but... nothing like this. This is the first time I've ever felt this low for this long.
Did something stressful happen in your life shortly before this started?

No, honestly... I can't really think of anything. Things were just normal. I mean, work gets a little busy sometimes, but nothing out of the ordinary happened. There wasn't really a major event or a trigger that I can point to... it just sort of started.
Do you find yourself worrying excessively about a lot of different things?

No, not really. I mean, I worry about normal things sometimes, like anyone else, but it's not excessive. I don't sit around stressing over a bunch of different things. It's more just this heavy, exhausted feeling than feeling worried.
